correctness.rationale: Exact binomial transform, stars-and-bars count and consecutive ratio give values of a monic degree-r polynomial at r distinct points; difference of two such polynomials has degree <r and r roots, hence zero. The recovered negative roots are exactly the exponent multiset. Direct exact arithmetic confirms r=2,3,4 sharpness pairs and 33,487 sample exponent shapes; r=1 sharpness is elementary. No finite test is substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: Determines how much of the ordered nontrivial factorization polynomial suffices to recover its exponent shape, with a bound depending only on distinct prime support rather than arbitrarily large total multiplicity. The explicit r=1..4 collisions demonstrate genuine finite-information sharpness in the smallest supports; no optimality is asserted for larger supports.
